decision.question: Should the site alter the font after Impeccable overused-font warnings?
decision.answer: Yes. The display face was changed from Fraunces to locally hosted Literata roman and italic variable assets.
decision.reason_for_self_hosting: Deterministic local build, fewer third-party requests, privacy, and performance control. Google Fonts was used only to discover and download the selected open font assets.
